Interface TurGenAiStoreProvider

All Known Implementing Classes:
TurChromaStoreProvider, TurLuceneStoreProvider, TurMilvusStoreProvider, TurPgVectorStoreProvider
public interface TurGenAiStoreProvider
Pluggable backend for embedding/vector storage. Implementations bridge a particular store (Chroma, PGVector, Lucene, Milvus, …) into Spring AI's VectorStore abstraction and expose admin operations (collection lifecycle, listing, export, import) used by the React console.

    • listChunks

      default TurStoreChunkPage listChunks(TurStoreInstance turStoreInstance, String decryptedCredential, String collectionName, int page, int pageSize, Map<String, List<String>> filters)
      Paginates over the chunks stored in collectionName without computing similarity — used by the ANN admin UI when the search field is empty (or *) to browse all indexed content. Filters mirror the search endpoint: an AND-of-IN over scalar metadata.

      Default implementation throws UnsupportedOperationException since not every backend exposes a native list-with-pagination API. Implement on a per-store basis using its native cursor/limit/offset.

      Since:
      2026.2.4

    • importChunks

      default TurStoreImportResult importChunks(TurStoreInstance turStoreInstance, String decryptedCredential, String collectionName, Iterable<TurStoreExportRecord> records, org.springframework.ai.embedding.EmbeddingModel embeddingModel)
      Bulk upserts the given records into collectionName. Records whose TurStoreExportRecord.embedding() is null/empty are re-embedded using embeddingModel; records that already have a vector are persisted verbatim.

      Default implementation throws UnsupportedOperationException — admin-style imports rely on each backend's native upsert (Chroma's upsertEmbeddings, PGVector's batch INSERT, …) so the provider decides the contract. Spring AI's VectorStore.add(List) is not used: Document in 2.x has no embedding setter, so add() would force a re-embed for every record and silently discard the JSONL vectors.

      Parameters:
      embeddingModel - non-null when any input record may lack a vector — required to re-embed; ignored when every record already has an embedding.
      Since:
      2026.2.4
